title: Sylow-cover associated sheaf construction with natural stalk comparisons
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $U$ an irreducible scheme [def-weil-irreducible-components], and $G$ a finite locally constant sheaf of $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf F_\ell)$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. There exist a connected finite etale cover $v:V\to U$ [def-weil-connected-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a natural number $d$ prime to $\ell$, and a finite $\ell$-group $P$, such that every geometric fibre of $v$ has cardinality $d$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-fibre]. There are a finite-dimensional $\mathbf F_\ell$-representation $M$ of $P$ and an additive functor $T$ from all $\mathbf F_\ell$-representations of $P$ to module sheaves on $V$. For each point $x$ of $V$, the composite of $T$, the universe-lifted geometric stalk at the algebraic closure of the residue field at $x$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and restriction of scalars along $\mathbf F_\ell\simeq\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf F_\ell)$ is naturally isomorphic to the underlying-module functor. Moreover $T(M)\simeq v^*G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and $T$ sends the trivial rank-one representation to the constant coefficient sheaf. A representation is a vector space equipped with a linear $P$-action; its morphisms are equivariant linear maps. No global preservation of finite limits or colimits is asserted.

proof.text: Choose a geometric point of the nonempty connected irreducible scheme U. Under the finite monodromy correspondence G is a finite-dimensional ZMod ℓ-module. Its finite image Q acts faithfully. Choose an ℓ-Sylow subgroup P; its index d is prime to ℓ. Replace P by an isomorphic finite group in Type u if necessary. The connected Galois Q-cover Y determines the connected cover V=Y/P. Functoriality identifies the pulled-back sheaf with the restriction M of the representation to P.

proof.text: The cover is finite étale, hence finite locally free. Its degree is locally constant on connected U and invariant under residue-field extension. Over a separably closed geometric point its algebra splits into copies of the field, whose number is both its degree and the number of geometric lifts. At the chosen point this number is [Q:P]=d, hence all the geometric fibres have cardinality d.

proof.text: Descend the constant module sheaf on the finite P-torsor Y over V, transporting scalars through ZMod l ≃ ULift (ZMod l), to obtain an additive functor T on all P-representations. Each action is continuous because P is finite discrete. Equivariant linear maps descend and preserve addition. Choose a point of Y over each canonical algebraic-closure point of V. It identifies the torsor fibre with P, and thus identifies the stalk of T naturally in the representation with its underlying module, after restricting coefficients along the inverse ULift ring equivalence. The restricted monodromy representation M descends to v*G; the trivial rank-one representation has identity transition functions and descends to the constant coefficient sheaf. No preservation of global finite limits or colimits is asserted in this construction step.

theorem Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.exists_sylow_cover_stalk_data
    {U : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace U] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
    [IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] :
    ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ U) (_ : IsFinite v) (_ : Etale v) (_ : ConnectedSpace V)
      (d : ℕ), ¬ ℓ ∣ d ∧
      (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U),
        Nat.card (v.GeometricFiber s) = d) ∧
      ∃ (P : Type u) (_ : Group P) (_ : Finite P), IsPGroup ℓ P ∧
        ∃ (M : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P) (_ : FiniteDimensional (ZMod ℓ) M.V)
          (T : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P ⥤
            Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
          (_ : T.Additive),
          (∀ x : V, Nonempty
            (T ⋙ (V.uliftPointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber
                  (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))) ⋙
                ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1}
                  (ULift.ringEquiv.symm.toRingHom : ZMod ℓ →+* ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)) ≅
              forget₂ (Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))) ∧
          Nonempty (T.obj M ≅ (v)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))].obj G) ∧
          Nonempty (T.obj (Rep.trivial (ZMod ℓ) P (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))) ≅
            (constantSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))).obj
              (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
